description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'IndividualClientData' representing clients with associated loans and savings data for a financial application, including factory methods and accessors.

classes.name: IndividualClientData
classes.description: Immutable data object for clients with loans due for disbursement or collection.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of IndividualClientData with specified client ID and name, initializing loans and savings to null.

methods.name: withSavings
methods.description: Returns a new IndividualClientData instance with the specified savings, retaining existing client ID, name, and loans.

methods.name: withLoans
methods.description: Returns a new IndividualClientData instance with the specified loans, retaining existing client ID, name, and savings.

methods.name: getLoans
methods.description: Returns the collection of loans associated with the client.

methods.name: setLoans
methods.description: Sets the collection of loans for this client.

methods.name: addLoans
methods.description: Adds a LoanDueData object to the collection of loans.

methods.name: getSavings
methods.description: Returns the collection of savings associated with the client.

methods.name: setSavings
methods.description: Sets the collection of savings for this client.

methods.name: addSavings
methods.description: Adds a SavingsDueData object to the collection of savings.
